doc: The mix as data (features/audio/audio_buses.gd builds the buses at boot, no default_bus_layout.tres). buses: id, parent bus id ('' = Master), volume_db. voice_cap_per_frame: most new positional voices started in one rendered frame (a riot frame can ask for dozens). pool_size: AudioStreamPlayer2D voices. m_to_px: audio-space pixels per metre (cue max_m scales by it). attenuation: AudioStreamPlayer2D attenuation exponent. panning_strength: 0..1 stereo spread for the top-down camera. duck: while a voice line plays, these buses drop by duck_db over duck_attack_s and recover over duck_release_s (rendered frames, not ticks). loudness: the targets the files were normalised to (tools/audio/process.py). footstep_speed_mps: Rivet's speed above which footsteps play. servo_chance: odds a footstep run also gets Rivet's servo whine.
